description: Personal finance and banking app — accounts, transactions, cards, budgets, savings goals. Finance industry only.
routing_note: Finance × Dashboard SaaS routes here instead of dashboard_core. Finance is the only industry where Dashboard SaaS means a banking/fintech product, not a generic B2B SaaS.

three_js.description: Precise orthographic grid lines with floating number clusters. Clean and architectural. No organic shapes. Gold accent lines pulse at intersections.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: User owns or belongs to an Organisation
Account belongs to User or Organisation — bank, credit, investment, crypto
Budget belongs to User or Organisation, tracks spending by category
Goal belongs to User — savings target, debt payoff, investment milestone
Report is generated from Transactions and Metrics
Metric is a computed value — net worth, savings rate, burn rate, ROI
Portfolio belongs to User or Organisation, contains investment holdings
Alert belongs to User, fires on threshold breach or unusual activity
Integration connects Account to external financial institution or service
AuditLog records all financial actions by Users

layout.notes: Balance is always the hero — the most prominent number on every home screen across all form factors. Sensitive data masked by default — tap to reveal. Biometric confirmation before any money movement.

avoid: Never show full account number — mask all but last 4 digits always
Never use red for anything except genuinely negative balances, failed payments, or overdraft states
Never use green for anything except positive balances, completed transactions, and successful payments
Never animate balance numbers casually — counter animations only on first load, never on refresh
Never use playful fonts, rounded bubbly UI, or casual illustrations — trust requires precision
Never show a transaction without: date, merchant name, amount, and status
Never allow destructive actions without biometric or PIN confirmation
Never auto-log out without warning — always show session timeout countdown with extend option
enforce: Balance always shown with 2 decimal places — £1,234.56 never £1,234
Debit transactions in red, credit transactions in green — always, no exceptions
Transaction amount always right-aligned in transaction lists
Biometric authentication offered on every app open after initial setup
Security lock icon visible in header on all sensitive screens
Transaction pending state always shown distinctly — pending label, grey amount
Card number masked by default — tap eye icon to reveal temporarily
Send money confirmation always shows: recipient name, amount, fee if any — before final confirm

empty_states.ui: Card visual shown with £0.00. 'Add money to get started' CTA prominent. Quick action buttons visible but greyed if insufficient balance — never hidden.
Transaction list illustration. Message: 'No transactions yet'. Sub: 'Your transactions will appear here'. CTA: 'Add money'.
Card placeholder illustration. Message: 'Order your card'. CTA: 'Get a card'. Show estimated delivery time.

loading_states.ui: Balance skeleton — large number placeholder shimmer. Card visual loads immediately from cache. Transaction list skeleton — 5 rows with amount placeholder right-aligned.
Date group headers load first. Transaction rows skeleton — merchant name left, amount right, both shimmer. Never reorder transactions during load.
Recipient lookup shows spinner in search field. Amount field active immediately. Fee calculation shows 'Calculating...' then updates.

error_flows.ui: Payment blocked. Red inline error: 'Insufficient funds. Your balance is [amount]'. Show shortfall. CTA: 'Top up' or 'Pay less'. Never just decline silently.
Full screen error: 'Payment declined'. Reason if available: 'Insufficient funds / Card blocked / Incorrect PIN'. Contact support CTA. Never cryptic code.
Transaction shows failed state in history. Money returned to balance immediately. Notification sent. Retry with corrected details option.
Push notification immediately. In-app: 'We noticed unusual activity'. Transaction temporarily frozen. Options: 'This was me' / 'This wasn't me'. Instant card freeze if needed.

edge_cases.ui: Balance shown in red. Overdraft limit and usage shown clearly. Warning banner. No new outgoing transactions allowed unless overdraft is authorised.
Additional verification step — biometric plus reason for payment. This is a trust and compliance requirement, not optional.
Show original currency amount, exchange rate, and fee all before confirmation. Never hide the FX cost until after payment.
Available balance updates in real time. Pending transactions shown with clock icon. Available balance = total minus pending.
